title: Downtown Detroit’s #1 Pedal Pub Experience!
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Explore Detroit's vibrant culture while cruising on the city's top-rated Rolling Social Party Bike. Perfect for birthdays, bachelorette parties, and corporate outings, this pedal-powered adventure combines music, drinks, and social fun. Enjoy a scenic ride featuring iconic landmarks and local hotspots, with the option for karaoke to elevate the experience. With group sizes ranging from 6 to 15, gather your friends for an unforgettable outing.

- Group tours for 6-15 riders with a 1hr 45min duration
- BYOB policy allows you to bring your own beverages (beer, wine, pre-mixed drinks)
- Stops at downtown highlights like The Spirit of Detroit, Campus Martius, Tin Roof and Downtown Hottest spots
- Ideal for celebrations, team-building events, or just a night out in Detroit
